reference_answer: On November 19, 2024 a customer of a franchised Yuen Kee store in Haidian District, Beijing found a foreign object in a fresh meat wonton noodle dish; it escalated into public/media attention. The store paid the customer RMB500 and was fined RMB15,000. After suspending the store for rectification, the company (1) ran a nationwide special food inspection on vegetable cleaning, staff discipline and pest control with written rectification notices and store-by-store verification; (2) standardized a four-step vegetable cleaning procedure (soaking, two rinses, drying, re-check) and tightened acceptance of store-procured vegetables; (3) installed pest-prevention facilities (insect-proof curtains, insect screens); and (4) adopted a more transparent, timely public-opinion response mechanism with stronger complaint handling and escalation.

question: Under SP 800-171 Rev. 3 requirement 03.06.02, within how many hours must suspected incidents be reported to the organizational incident response capability?
reference_answer: SP 800-171 Rev. 3 does not set a number of hours. Requirement 03.06.02 says to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within an '[Assignment: organization-defined time period]' (p.49), i.e. the period is an organization-defined parameter; Appendix D (p.117) lists it without a value, and NIST does not assign values to organization-defined parameters (p.14, footnote 14).
